name: Impetus of Athena
description:
You approach combat in 10-second battle cycles, each with [blue]10 Aegis🛡️[/blue]. You must use [blue]1🛡️[/blue] to shoot or manually attack, or you can double tap [gold]movement keys[/gold] while blocking to spend 🛡️ to execute battle actions:

  • [gold]W:[/gold] [blue](3🛡️)[/blue] Enter [effect:warfare][dark-gray]warfare stance[/dark-gray][/effect] for 3 attacks.

  • [gold]A:[/gold] [blue](2🛡️)[/blue] Stealth and prepare an [effect:ambush][dark-gray]ambush[/dark-gray][/effect].

  • [gold]S:[/gold] [blue](2-4🛡️)[/blue] Petrify those facing you with the Gorgon [effect:stare][dark-gray]stare[/dark-gray][/effect].

  • [gold]D:[/gold] (4🛡️) Plant a [effect:decoy][dark-gray]decoy trap zone[/dark-gray][/effect] at the target area.

[dark-gray]"Excel where they can't - in the beauty of well-laid plans."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Strike in a cone behind the target, dealing +2-5❤️ base damage to all targets scaling with how unarmored each target is.
Stealth and gain 20% speed for 3 seconds. If you exit stealth by attacking, you critically strike for 1.5x base damage and shred 50% of the target's armor for 5 seconds.
Stuns for 3 seconds, costing 2-4🛡️ for 1-3+ affected enemies. Players always cost 3🛡. Attacks which break petrification deal +2-5❤️ executing base damage, +2❤️ per parry this battle cycle.

A temporary 4x4 zone centered on a 5❤️ decoy which is hidden from other players and attracts mobs. Enemies who enter the zone or hit the decoy are parried and automatically attacked by you, ignoring the range.
